title: Partially Funded LESA: Semi-Annual Installments to the Borrower
content:
The Partially Funded LESA is the plan of Set-Aside Accounts that pays its funds to the borrower in semi-annual installments; the borrower then pays the property charges personally and remains responsible for paying them on time. Only plans that pay semi-annual borrower installments pay them.

## Terms of the installment

- **When.** An installment is paid on the plan's installment day of each month the plan lists, by ACH to the borrower, recorded against that month as the installment month.
- **How much.** The installment is the semi-annual installment amount fixed at closing on the plan's sizing basis, or the remaining balance when that is smaller; when the remaining balance is the amount paid, the set-aside then depletes.
- **Status.** A semi-annual installment is paid only while the set-aside status is active.
- **Loan status.** No installment is paid once the loan is due and payable, because this plan does not continue paying while the loan is due and payable, and none is paid for a month before the loan funded.
- **Once per month.** Each installment month is paid at most once: a month that already shows an installment on the set-aside's ledger is not paid again.

In other words, each installment equals the lesser of the fixed semi-annual installment amount and the set-aside balance at the time of payment.

## Hypothetical cases

| Fixed installment | Balance before payment | Installment paid | Balance after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1,200.00 | 5,000.00 | 1,200.00 | 3,800.00 |
| 1,200.00 | 1,200.00 | 1,200.00 | 0.00 (depletes) |
| 1,200.00 | 800.00 | 800.00 | 0.00 (depletes) |

A month whose installment already appears on the ledger, a set-aside whose status is depleted, a loan that is due and payable, and a month before the loan funded each lead to no installment.
